dashboard.label: LogScrub — Overview
dashboard.description: Explore PII and secret detection across your data using the | sanitize command.

search.query: $tok_index$ | head 500 | sanitize standard=$tok_standard$ mask_style=$tok_mask_style$ report_findings=true | where isnotnull(_raw_findings) | stats count
$tok_index$ | head 500 | sanitize standard=$tok_standard$ mask_style=$tok_mask_style$ report_findings=true | where isnotnull(_raw_finding_count) | stats sum(_raw_finding_count) as total

$tok_index$ | head 500 | sanitize standard=$tok_standard$ report_findings=true | where isnotnull(_raw_findings) | makemv delim="," _raw_findings | mvexpand _raw_findings | rename _raw_findings as pattern | stats count by pattern | sort -count
$tok_index$ | head 500 | sanitize standard=$tok_standard$ report_findings=true | where isnotnull(_raw_findings) | stats count by host | sort -count | head 10

$tok_index$ | head 50 | sanitize standard=$tok_standard$ mask_style=$tok_mask_style$ report_findings=true | where isnotnull(_raw_findings) | table _time, host, sourcetype, _raw, _raw_findings, _raw_finding_count | rename _raw as "Scrubbed _raw", _raw_findings as "Patterns Found", _raw_finding_count as "Count"
